# Minecraft Terms

Adds Minecraft terminology to [Code Spell Checker](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=streetsidesoftware.code-spell-checker).
The same word list is available to the [`cspell`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cspell) command-line
linter through `@pumpkin-plugins/cspell-dict-minecraft`. It covers Minecraft generally and excludes
PumpkinMC-specific terms.

<!-- docs:begin reference -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs from package, action, extension, and component docs metadata. Run `pnpm readme`. -->

See the [API reference](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/api/extensions/minecraft-terms/) on the documentation site.
<!-- docs:end reference -->

Install Code Spell Checker and this extension. It registers the packaged dictionary when VS Code
starts. For `cspell` in npm projects, install `@pumpkin-plugins/cspell-dict-minecraft` and import its
`cspell-ext.json` in your CSpell configuration. See the [dictionary package's install instructions](../../tools/cspell-dict-minecraft/README.md#install)
for the pnpm command and YAML example.

This extension is distributed as a VSIX attached to its GitHub release. In VS Code, select
**Extensions: Install from VSIX...** and choose the downloaded `.vsix` file.
